name: The Century Maker
coach_speak: Batting for 3 hours means your legs and core give out before your eyes do. This circuit builds the muscular stamina to keep your stance rock solid and your sprints fast in the 40th over.

name: Crease Scrambler EMOM
coach_speak: You have to explode, recover instantly, and brace your core for the next ball. This EMOM format trains your heart rate to drop quickly so you are composed when the bowler runs in.

name: The Tiebreaker Engine
coach_speak: In the 3rd set, oxygen is a luxury. This circuit spikes your heart rate on the SkiErg and forces your legs to produce power through the sled and bounds when completely starved of oxygen.

name: Rotational Armor EMOM
coach_speak: Your core is the bridge between your foot plant and your racket speed. If your core fatigues, you hit the net. This builds a bulletproof bridge that doesn't collapse under fatigue.

name: The Low-Stance Crucible
coach_speak: Whether you're dinking at the kitchen or returning a wide serve, you live in a low squat. We are building massive isometric endurance in your quads and glutes so your stance never breaks down.

name: Cuff & Smash Resilience
coach_speak: Swinging a racket 500 times a match shreds the rotator cuff. This circuit flushes the shoulders with blood and builds the braking capacity needed to decelerate the arm safely.

name: The Deceleration Matrix
coach_speak: You don't get hurt speeding up; you get hurt slamming the brakes. Reverse sleds and Cossack squats bulletproof your knees and adductors to handle extreme lateral stops.

name: X-Sling Power Grid
coach_speak: Power is generated in the opposite hip and transferred to the opposite shoulder. This circuit forces your brain to wire those diagonal fascial slings together under heavy metabolic stress.

name: Alactic Death Intervals
coach_speak: Racquet sports are just a series of violent 5-to-10 second car crashes. We are training your body's fastest energy system to empty the tank and completely recharge in under 45 seconds.

name: Bilateral-to-Unilateral Transfer
coach_speak: We recruit every muscle fiber with the heavy Trap Bar, then immediately force you to stabilize that power on one leg. It's exactly what happens when you leap for a high volley and land on one foot.

name: The Sled Friction Simulator
coach_speak: The sleds in Hyrox are about overcoming massive friction under fatigue. This circuit forces you to generate horizontal force, immediately pull backwards, and then flush the lactic acid on the SkiErg. The wall sit teaches your quads to suffer.

name: Grip Death & Flush
coach_speak: Station 6 is the Farmer's Carry. If your grip fails, your race is over. We are blowing up your forearms and then forcing you to pull on the rower when you have zero grip strength left. Survive this, and the race feels easy.

name: Rox Station Crucible (No-Run)
coach_speak: This is pure station simulation without the impact of the 8km run. You have to learn how to transition from heavy legs on the lunge directly into the explosive squatting of the wall ball without redlining your heart rate.

name: Posterior Chain Engine
coach_speak: The SkiErg, Rower, and Sled Pull will completely fry your back and hamstrings. This EMOM builds a bulletproof posterior chain so you don't cramp up when you have to bend over and pull the sled rope.

name: The Lactic Wall Ball Pre-Exhaust
coach_speak: You hit the wall balls at the very end of the race when your legs are dead. We are pre-exhausting your quads with sandbag squats and the bike, so you learn how to use your hips to throw the ball instead of just your knees.

name: Off-Feet VO2 Max Intervals
coach_speak: You can build a massive aerobic engine without pounding your joints on the pavement. This is high-output off-feet conditioning. Hit your target splits on every single machine without dropping pace.

name: Sandbag Lunge Resilience
coach_speak: The 100m sandbag lunge destroys unconditioned glutes. We are using isometric holds and deficit lunges to build extreme time-under-tension so you can carry that 20kg bag unbroken.

name: Burpee Broad Jump (BBJ) Explosiveness
energy_system: Hip Hinge Power & Upper Body Push
coach_speak: The BBJ station requires a massive upper body push followed by a violent hip hinge. We are isolating those two movements under fatigue so you can cover maximum distance on every jump instead of taking baby hops.
